artifacts.component: Microsoft .NET Windows Desktop Runtime (x64 installer)
artifacts.license: Microsoft's terms for the .NET runtime, which its installer shows - not read for this entry, because the file was not downloaded to record it
artifacts.upstream: https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json - Microsoft's release metadata for the 10.0 channel, where the sha512 above is published for release 10.0.12 (8 September 2026, a security release); the copy at dotnetcli.blob.core.windows.net gives the same value
artifacts.used_by: section_files_64.iss (DotNet\{#DOTNET_RUNTIME_FILE}); installed by InstallDotNetRuntime() in hMailServerInnoExtension.iss when no .NET 10 Desktop Runtime is present
artifacts.why: The Control Panel and the database tools are .NET 10 applications, and DBSetup, DBSetupQuick and DBUpdater run during installation, so the installer carries the runtime and installs it where none of .NET 10 is present. Not in git (60 MB; .gitignore excludes installation/DotNet). build/get-dotnet-runtime.ps1 downloads exactly this version from 'source' and refuses any file whose SHA-512 is not the one here, which is the value Microsoft publishes for it; the file keeps the channel's name, which is the name the installer script builds from DOTNET_CHANNEL. Until 25 September 2026 the script took whatever aka.ms/dotnet/10.0 pointed at and checked only that it was larger than 40 MB. build/show-dotnet-runtime-pin.ps1 prints these fields for another version; ThirdPartyBinaries.md, 'Moving the .NET runtime pin', says how to move it. The size and the signature are not recorded because the file was not downloaded to record this entry: the hash is Microsoft's own.

artifacts.component: 7-Zip standalone console (7za.exe)
artifacts.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause - text at hmailserver/docs/Licenses/License - 7Zip.rtf (the package's License.txt)
artifacts.upstream: https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z2603-extra.7z - the 7-Zip Extra package of 7-Zip 26.03 (3 September 2026), served by 7-zip.org itself; the member x64/7za.exe
artifacts.used_by: Compression::GetExecutableFullPath_() in hmailserver/source/Server/Common/Util/Compression.cpp; run from {app}\Bin to write, list and extract the backup's archives
artifacts.why: Writes and restores the backup's archives, as the service account. 19.00 (2019) predated the fixes for CVE-2023-31102 (a crafted 7z archive, the PPMd decoder) and CVE-2025-55188 (symbolic links written during extraction), and the security scan of 25 September 2026 named it the most serious finding; moved to 26.03 that day. Every switch the server passes is in 26.03's own usage text, and the restore lists an archive's entries before it extracts any (Compression::CheckEntries). Fetched from 7-zip.org and not from the GitHub release its download page links to; the package is a 7z archive, which build/get-installer-binaries.ps1 opens with Windows' own tar.exe.

dispositions.retain: committed on purpose, with the reason in 'why'
dispositions.retain-generated: generated from this repository's own sources and committed for the build's convenience
dispositions.gathered: not in git; copied from the build machine by build/get-installer-binaries.ps1 and verified against 'sha256'
dispositions.system: not in git; a file of the Windows installation, copied from the path in 'source' by build/get-installer-binaries.ps1 (-SystemOnly for a build that needs nothing else); it varies with the Windows build, so 'sha256' is reported, not enforced
dispositions.generated: not in git; produced from this repository's own sources by build/generate-com-wrapper.ps1 on every build, with no 'sha256' because the output is not byte-reproducible
dispositions.fetched: not in git; downloaded from the build-inputs release named in 'source' by build/get-installer-binaries.ps1 and verified against 'sha256'
dispositions.platform: not a disposition: an artifact with "platform": "arm64" is the ARM64 installer's (hmailserver/docs/WindowsOnArm.md), placed by get-installer-binaries.ps1 and get-dotnet-runtime.ps1 only with -Platform ARM64; an artifact without it is the x64 installer's or the build's
dispositions.downloaded: not in git; downloaded from the vendor's own address in 'source' by the script 'why' names (build/get-dotnet-runtime.ps1) and verified against 'sha512', the hash the vendor publishes for that exact version; nothing else is accepted
